source.source_title: Anthracite: Pre-Shift Examinations of Underground Mines
source.why_this_clip: A miner's hand lifts a cylindrical metal safety lamp with a barred cage into frame and holds it up, the lamp swaying and tilting a little as it is raised. The interval starts once the whole lamp is in frame at 5.0 s and ends before the camera moves in at about 7.75 s; the only cut is at 18.0 s.
